about.notices.colorSchemes.title.comment: Title of a button row in the About page's Acknowledgements card, under the sentence about the built-in color schemes. Not formatted. Activating it opens, in Finder, the folder inside the app that holds the attribution and MIT license text for the palette values the color schemes adapt. Use the same word for color scheme as the Theme page. Keep it short.
about.notices.colorSchemes.title.ja: カラースキームのライセンス表示

about.notices.open.hint.comment: Second line of the two notice button rows in the About page's Acknowledgements card, and the VoiceOver hint for them. Not formatted. It says what activating the row does: it opens a folder that is stored inside the app, in the Finder window. Keep the product name Finder unchanged.
